package task

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
)

type lessonRepoStub struct {
	items map[string]domain.Lesson
}

func (s lessonRepoStub) Create(repository.Context, domain.Lesson) error {
	return nil
}

func (s lessonRepoStub) Get(_ repository.Context, id string) (*domain.Lesson, error) {
	item, ok := s.items[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return &item, nil
}

func (s lessonRepoStub) GetWithFields(repository.Context, string, queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (s lessonRepoStub) Update(repository.Context, domain.Lesson) error {
	return nil
}

func (s lessonRepoStub) Delete(repository.Context, string) error {
	return nil
}

type taskRepoStub struct {
	items map[string][]domain.Task
}

func (s taskRepoStub) Create(repository.Context, domain.Task) error {
	return nil
}

func (s taskRepoStub) Update(repository.Context, domain.Task) error {
	return nil
}

func (s taskRepoStub) Delete(repository.Context, string) error {
	return nil
}

func (s taskRepoStub) Get(repository.Context, string) (*domain.Task, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (s taskRepoStub) GetWithFields(repository.Context, string, queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (s taskRepoStub) ListByLesson(_ repository.Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.Task, error) {
	return s.items[lessonID], nil
}

func (s taskRepoStub) ListByLessonFields(repository.Context, string, queryfields.Set, filters.TaskFilters, *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	return nil, 0, nil
}

type progressProviderStub struct {
	items map[string]TaskProgress
}

func (s progressProviderStub) GetProgressByTaskIDs(context.Context, string, []string) (map[string]TaskProgress, error) {
	return s.items, nil
}

func TestGetInternalCompletedLessonsCountsPassedAndUnderReview(t *testing.T) {
	uc := GetInternalCompletedLessons{
		Lessons: lessonRepoStub{
			items: map[string]domain.Lesson{
				"lesson-auto":   {ID: "lesson-auto", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive},
				"lesson-manual": {ID: "lesson-manual", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive},
				"lesson-hybrid": {ID: "lesson-hybrid", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive},
			},
		},
		Tasks: taskRepoStub{
			items: map[string][]domain.Task{
				"lesson-auto": {
					{ID: "task-auto", Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, EvaluationMode: domain.TaskEvaluationModeAuto},
				},
				"lesson-manual": {
					{ID: "task-manual", Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, EvaluationMode: domain.TaskEvaluationModeManual},
				},
				"lesson-hybrid": {
					{ID: "task-hybrid", Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, EvaluationMode: domain.TaskEvaluationModeHybrid},
				},
			},
		},
		Progress: progressProviderStub{
			items: map[string]TaskProgress{
				"task-auto":   {TaskID: "task-auto", HasPassed: true},
				"task-manual": {TaskID: "task-manual", HasUnderReview: true},
				"task-hybrid": {TaskID: "task-hybrid", HasUnderReview: true},
			},
		},
	}

	result, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), "user-1", []string{"lesson-hybrid", "lesson-manual", "lesson-auto"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Handle returned error: %v", err)
	}

	want := []string{"lesson-auto", "lesson-hybrid", "lesson-manual"}
	if len(result.CompletedLessonIDs) != len(want) {
		t.Fatalf("completed len = %d, want %d", len(result.CompletedLessonIDs), len(want))
	}
	for i, lessonID := range want {
		if result.CompletedLessonIDs[i] != lessonID {
			t.Fatalf("completed[%d] = %s, want %s", i, result.CompletedLessonIDs[i], lessonID)
		}
	}
}

func TestGetInternalCompletedLessonsSkipsInactiveAndIncompleteLessons(t *testing.T) {
	uc := GetInternalCompletedLessons{
		Lessons: lessonRepoStub{
			items: map[string]domain.Lesson{
				"lesson-inactive":   {ID: "lesson-inactive", Status: domain.LessonStatusNoActive},
				"lesson-incomplete": {ID: "lesson-incomplete", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive},
			},
		},
		Tasks: taskRepoStub{
			items: map[string][]domain.Task{
				"lesson-inactive": {
					{ID: "task-inactive", Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, EvaluationMode: domain.TaskEvaluationModeAuto},
				},
				"lesson-incomplete": {
					{ID: "task-incomplete", Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, EvaluationMode: domain.TaskEvaluationModeAuto},
				},
			},
		},
		Progress: progressProviderStub{
			items: map[string]TaskProgress{
				"task-incomplete": {TaskID: "task-incomplete", HasUnderReview: true},
			},
		},
	}

	result, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), "user-1", []string{"lesson-inactive", "lesson-incomplete"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Handle returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if len(result.CompletedLessonIDs) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("completed lessons = %#v, want empty", result.CompletedLessonIDs)
	}
}

func TestGetInternalCompletedLessonsTreatsLessonsWithoutActiveTasksAsCompleted(t *testing.T) {
	uc := GetInternalCompletedLessons{
		Lessons: lessonRepoStub{
			items: map[string]domain.Lesson{
				"lesson-empty": {ID: "lesson-empty", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive},
			},
		},
		Tasks: taskRepoStub{
			items: map[string][]domain.Task{
				"lesson-empty": {
					{ID: "task-draft", Status: domain.TaskStatusNoActive, EvaluationMode: domain.TaskEvaluationModeAuto},
				},
			},
		},
		Progress: progressProviderStub{items: map[string]TaskProgress{}},
	}

	result, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), "user-1", []string{"lesson-empty"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Handle returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if len(result.CompletedLessonIDs) != 1 || result.CompletedLessonIDs[0] != "lesson-empty" {
		t.Fatalf("completed lessons = %#v, want [lesson-empty]", result.CompletedLessonIDs)
	}
}
